LOMON® R-996 pigment is a zirconia and alumina treated rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the sulfate process. It is a highly durable, versatile pigment suitable for a wide range of applications.

Careful control of the TiO2 particle size during the manufacturing process of LOMON® R-996 pigment results in good brightness, high opacity and easy dispersibility.

Building on our successful track record in international markets, we are expanding our presence in emerging economies through localized technical support and flexible supply solutions.
